programme.title: Look At Life Down London River
programme.desc: 1962. A Look into a leisurely journey through London along the Thames.

programme.title: Target: The Corruptors
programme.desc: The Wrecker. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland & Harold J. Stone. Investigative reporters Paul Marino & Jack Flood investigate various cases of industrial corruption. (S1, E22)

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: Disasters, Humiliations & Embarrassing Moments In Their Personal & Professional Lives. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Diana Dors, Jimmy Jewel and Ted Ray. [S]

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Digging Out. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Kenneth Cranham. Working on a bomb at a gas works, the company finds a second bomb with a time fuze

programme.title: Lancashire Luck
programme.desc: 1937. Comedy. Director: Henry Cass. Stars George Carney, Wendy Hiller & Muriel George. A working class family win a fortune and enjoy the high life after moving to an upper class part of town. [S]

programme.title: To Dorothy A Son
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Director Muriel Box. Starring John Gregson, Shelley Winters & Peggy Cummins. Myrtle stands to inherit $2,000,000 if her ex doesn't have any male heirs, if he does, he gets the cash. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Let's get dancing! Enjoy this fantastic performance from Lionel and Joyce Blair as they dance to the 60s hit 'Must Be Madison'.

programme.title: Those People Next Door
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by John Harlow and starring Jack Warner, Charles Victor, Jimmy James & Anthony Newley. A young man's titled parents object to his working-class fiance. [S]

programme.title: The Laurel-Hardy Murder Case
programme.desc: 1930. Comedy. Director: James Parrott. Stars Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Frank Austin, Stanley Blystone. Laurel & Hardy get involved in a murder case after the death of Stan's rich uncle Ebenezer. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: Meet McGraw
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: Frank McDonald. Stars Frank Lovejoy, Audrey Totter & Ellen Corby. A private detective is hired to protect a woman after she claims that her husband is planning to kill her. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Dumb Witness. 1964. Stars John Barrie & Warren Mitchell. Sergeant Cork is called to help with a spate of burglaries but Leavis is unconvinced by his methods. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Articles of War. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, Eric Pohlmann & Brian Rawlinson. The island is running out of food and a Spanish naval ship threatens to destroy the next shipment. [S]

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Director: Roy William. Stars Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce, Patricia Morison & Edmond Breon. Sherlock Holmes & Dr. Watson hunt for the elusive plates before counterfeiters acquire them. [S]

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Mechanical Watchman. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, John Howlett & Peter Allenby. Maguire catches a fur coat thief in the act; however, the other members of the gang remain unknown. [S]

programme.title: Mrs. Pym of Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1939. Detective Drama. Directed by Fred Elles. Starring Mary Clare, Edward Lexy & Nigel Patrick. A woman detective sets about solving the murder of people who have all frequented the same medium. [S]

programme.title: Mr Denning Drives North
programme.desc: 1951. Crime. Director: Anthony Kimmins. Stars John Mills, Phyllis Calvert & Eileen Moore. A British aircraft engineer accidentally kills his daughter's boyfriend and then tries to it cover up... [S]

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are Lynda Bellingham, Robin Cousins, Tim Flavin, Bonnie Langford, Paul Nicholas and Marti Webb. [S]

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Bee Skeps/Flooded River Fishing. 1978. This specially preserved episode shows a traditional bee skep being made. Then, planning to fish in a stream on Salisbury Plain, Jack finds it in flood. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1961. The Never Never Murder. Directed by Peter Duffell. Starring Russell Napier, Genine Graham and Maurice Good. A dead body sets the police on the track of a fraudster. (S1, E37)

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's...
programme.desc: ...A Man Called Harry Brent. The Pen. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Mrs Tolly's husband puts a devious plan in action to obtain Mr Fielding's fountain pen. [S]

programme.title: Travelling Man
programme.desc: Grasser. 1984. Stars Leigh Lawson, Paul Chapman & Cathy Hytner. A bullet smashes through the window of Lomax's barge, believing someone is out to get him he seeks out the shooter. [S]

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Master
programme.desc: ... Blackmailer. 1992. Director: Peter Hammond. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke & Robert Hardy. Holmes and Watson attempt to break the grip of a ruthless blackmailer of their clients. [S]

programme.title: La Fin du Jour
programme.desc: 1939. Drama. Director: Julien Duvivier. Stars Louis Jouvet, Michel Simon & Victor Francen. A few actors live together in a retirement home. One day an old friend arrives, reigniting old feelings.
